definitions.explanation: A shop that sells flowers and floral arrangements. Can also refer to the person who owns or works at such a shop.

examples.japanese: {花屋|はなや}で{薔薇|ばら}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought roses at the flower shop.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{花屋|はなや}がある。
examples.english: There is a flower shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{花屋|はなや}で{働|はたら}いている。
{母|はは}の{日|ひ}の{前|まえ}は{花屋|はなや}が{混|こ}む。
examples.english: Flower shops get crowded before Mother's Day.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}の{花屋|はなや}で{誕生日|たんじょうび}プレゼントの{花束|はなたば}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a birthday bouquet at the neighborhood flower shop.

notes:
COMPOUND: {花|はな} (flower) + {屋|や} (shop)

COMMON SHOP NAMES WITH {屋|や}:
- {本屋|ほんや} (bookstore)
- {肉屋|にくや} (butcher shop)
- {魚屋|さかなや} (fish shop)
- {八百屋|やおや} (vegetable shop)
- パン{屋|や} (bakery)

RELATED:
- {花束|はなたば} (bouquet)
- {生|い}け{花|ばな} (flower arrangement, ikebana)
- {花|はな}を{生|い}ける (to arrange flowers)
